[[File:FarlanderUniform.jpg|250px|thumb|Farlander's uniform hanging in the cabin]]
'''Cabin 11489''' was the designation for [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]]'s quarters on board the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. He moved into the cabin shortly after joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Flight Cadet]].<ref name="TFP">{{StoryCite|story=The Farlander Papers|book=Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)}}</ref> The small, simple room included a desk, chair, [[Comm unit/Legends|comm-puter]], multi-species toilet, and a cot which came out of the wall at the touch of a button. The room was located in an area originally designed for [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] passengers and had much darker lighting that the species preferred.<ref name="Strategy Guide">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>
